name: rentemester-ownership-fact-lifecycle-v24
sql:
CREATE TABLE rm_ownership_fact_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 fact_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rm_ownership_facts(fact_hash),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type='ended'),
 effective_to_exclusive TEXT NOT NULL,
 successor_fact_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rm_ownership_facts(fact_hash),
 snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rm_ownership_source_snapshots(snapshot_id),
 actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service_account','local_operator')),
 principal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(fact_hash,event_type,effective_to_exclusive,successor_fact_hash)
);
CREATE TRIGGER rm_ownership_fact_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_ownership_fact_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ownership fact events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_ownership_fact_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_ownership_fact_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ownership fact events are append-only'); END;
